decisions.nm: McLean v. Minister of Justice
decisions.pe: A US English teacher in Japan joined peaceful protests. Japan refused to renew his visa. The Supreme Court said foreigners have constitutional rights, but the government has wide freedom to decide on visas.
decisions.pi: Seorang guru bahasa Inggris dari AS di Jepang ikut unjuk rasa damai. Jepang menolak memperpanjang visanya. MA menyatakan orang asing punya hak konstitusional, tetapi pemerintah punya keleluasaan luas atas visa.

decisions.nm: Chong Hyang Gyun v. Tokyo Metropolitan Government
decisions.pe: A Korean nurse born and working in Japan was not allowed to sit Tokyo’s promotion exam because she was not a citizen. The Supreme Court said this was allowed.
decisions.pi: Seorang perawat keturunan Korea yang lahir dan bekerja di Jepang tidak diizinkan mengikuti ujian promosi di Tokyo karena bukan warga negara. MA menyatakan hal itu boleh.

decisions.nm: Permanent residents and public assistance
decisions.pe: An elderly Chinese woman who had lived in Japan for decades was refused welfare. The Supreme Court said foreigners have no legal right to welfare, though the government may give it voluntarily.
decisions.pi: Seorang perempuan lanjut usia asal Tiongkok yang tinggal puluhan tahun di Jepang ditolak bantuan sosial. MA menyatakan orang asing tidak punya hak hukum atas bantuan sosial, walau pemerintah boleh memberinya secara sukarela.

decisions.nm: Nationality Act Article 3 case
decisions.pe: Children of Filipina mothers and Japanese fathers who were not married could not get Japanese nationality. The Supreme Court said this was unequal. The law was changed the same year.
decisions.pi: Anak-anak dari ibu Filipina dan ayah Jepang yang tidak menikah tidak bisa mendapat kewarganegaraan Jepang. MA menyatakan ini tidak setara. UU diubah pada tahun yang sama.

decisions.nm: Le Thi Thuy Linh case (technical intern acquitted)
decisions.pe: A young Vietnamese woman working on a farm in Japan hid her pregnancy because she feared being sent home. Her twins were stillborn and she was convicted of abandoning their bodies. The Supreme Court acquitted her.
decisions.pi: Seorang perempuan muda Vietnam yang bekerja di pertanian di Jepang menyembunyikan kehamilannya karena takut dipulangkan. Bayi kembarnya lahir meninggal dan ia divonis menelantarkan jenazah. MA membebaskannya.

decisions.nm: Local voting rights of permanent residents
decisions.pe: Korean permanent residents asked to vote in local elections. The Supreme Court said the Constitution does not give them that right, but Parliament could give it by law.
decisions.pi: Penduduk tetap keturunan Korea meminta hak memilih dalam pemilihan daerah. MA menyatakan konstitusi tidak memberi hak itu, tetapi parlemen boleh memberikannya lewat UU.

decisions.nm: Lost earnings of an injured worker without a visa
decisions.pe: A Pakistani worker without a visa was injured in a Japanese factory. The Supreme Court said the employer must pay damages, counting Japanese wages for a limited time and home-country wages after that.
decisions.pi: Seorang pekerja Pakistan tanpa visa terluka di pabrik di Jepang. MA menyatakan majikan wajib membayar ganti rugi, menghitung upah Jepang untuk jangka terbatas lalu upah negara asal sesudahnya.

decisions.nm: Deportation right after an asylum refusal (Sri Lankan nationals)
decisions.pe: Two Sri Lankan men were told their asylum objection had failed and were put on a plane the next day. The Tokyo High Court said this denied them their right to go to court.
decisions.pi: Dua pria Sri Lanka diberi tahu keberatan suaka mereka gagal dan diterbangkan keesokan harinya. Pengadilan Tinggi Tokyo menyatakan ini menghilangkan hak mereka untuk ke pengadilan.

decisions.nm: Death of a Cameroonian man in immigration detention (Ushiku)
decisions.pe: A man from Cameroon died in 2014 in an immigration detention centre in Ushiku after crying out in pain through the night. The court said staff failed to get him to hospital and awarded damages to his family.
decisions.pi: Seorang pria dari Kamerun meninggal pada 2014 di pusat detensi imigrasi Ushiku setelah semalaman mengerang kesakitan. Pengadilan menyatakan petugas lalai membawanya ke rumah sakit dan memberi ganti rugi kepada keluarganya.

decisions.nm: Govinda Prasad Mainali retrial (Tokyo Electric Power employee murder case)
decisions.pe: Retrial acquittal of a Nepali migrant worker after 15 years in prison.
decisions.pi: Pembebasan dalam peninjauan kembali seorang pekerja migran Nepal setelah 15 tahun dipenjara.
